summary: Load a URL in a BrowserWindow renderer.

target.notes: Arbitrary web content requires a browser-compatible renderer/network stack unless a stronger static transformation is proven.

caveats: Remote URL loading cannot be considered Chromium-free native UI by default.
Navigation, CSP, redirects, cookies, session and renderer lifecycle can affect observable behavior.

tests.name: successful URL load
tests.expected_behavior: promise fulfills after successful load completion

tests.name: failed URL load
tests.expected_behavior: promise rejects/fails according to Electron navigation semantics
